channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: DeSantis allies accuse Lieutenant Governor's wife of running anonymous accounts attacking Governor
item.description: Several social media accounts were shut down after prominent members of Ron DeSantis' administration alleged that Layla Collins, wife of Lieutenant Governor Jay Collins, operated anonymous profiles used to criticize the governor. item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% this year, survey finds
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description: A fatal head-on collision claimed the life of a 40-year-old driver early Sunday morning on State Road 710 in Martin County. The crash occurred around 2 a.m. near the intersection of State Road 710, also known as Beeline Highway, and Southwest Silver Fox Lane, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, preserving the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain while connecting local and international artists through an artist-in-residency program.

item.title: Port St. Lucie moves forward with Midway Road expansion and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange at the Florida Turnpike on Midway Road.

item.title: St. Lucie County Marine Unit rescues two boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their small motorized boat sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday, thanks to a quick response from the St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit and the decision to wear life jackets.

item.title: Stuart breast cancer patient and surgeon speak out after insurance denial hours before reconstruction surgery
item.description: A Stuart breast cancer patient and her surgeon are speaking out after Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled, citing a surgical mesh as investigational.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes for $3 million renovation to nearly double slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be completed by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her Wimbledon doubles match with sister Venus on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina survives Cape Verde scare 3-2 in South Florida World Cup thriller
item.description: Lionel Messi and defending World Cup champion Argentina advanced to the Round of 16 after a dramatic extra-time match against underdog Cape Verde before a pro-Argentina crowd in South Florida.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state championship after 10-2 season and district title
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is targeting a state championship in the 2026 fall season after finishing last year with a 10-2 record and a district title. item.title: St. Lucie Mets Snap Nine-Game Skid With Late Comeback Win Over Tarpons
item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets ended their nine-game losing streak Sunday afternoon with a late offensive surge, rallying past the Tampa Tarpons for a 10-5 win at Clover Park.

item.title: Byron Donalds raises $90 million in Florida Governor's race as rivals struggle
item.description: U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds has consolidated nearly all major Republican endorsements and raised $90 million for his gubernatorial campaign while his rivals face fundraising and campaign troubles.

item.title: Florida students reach 60% proficiency milestone in reading and math
item.description: For the first time in state history, 60% of Florida students tested at or above grade level in both reading and math on the annual Florida Assessment of Student Thinking exam.

item.title: President Trump's 250th anniversary rally overshadows congressional commemoration commission
item.description: Trump held a campaign-style rally on the National Mall as the 250th anniversary of American independence approached, with his face displayed on banners fluttering from federal buildings across Washington.

item.title: U.S. men's soccer team faces Belgium in World Cup Round of 16 without suspended forward
item.description: The United States takes the field Monday night against Belgium at Lumen Field in Seattle after earning the program's first knockout stage victory since 2002.

item.title: Americans mark nation's 250th birthday with varied celebrations and subdued optimism
item.description: In interviews across the United States in the days before the Fourth of July, citizens expressed tempered enthusiasm about the nation's semiquincentennial.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic and rain to Florida Turnpike near St. Lucie
item.description: AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans traveled over the Fourth of July weekend, with 61.4 million driving. Heavy rain added to congestion on Florida roads including the Turnpike south of Orlando.
